question: Where is the closest fast food restaurant relative to the east of Plaza Sports Center, Edinburg, TX?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois AS fast_food_restaurants WHERE fast_food_restaurants.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_X(ST_Centroid(fast_food_restaurants.geometry)) > ST_X(ST_Centroid(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Plaza Sports Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ))) ORDER BY ST_Distance( fast_food_restaurants.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Plaza Sports Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
